description.p: RDPFlow manages saved Remote Desktop connections for the Linux desktop on top of FreeRDP. Passwords live in the system keyring, display and audio settings are stored per connection, and every session gets a live FreeRDP log.

ul.li: Saved connections with search and recent-use ordering
Passwords in the system keyring, never on disk in the config file
Display presets sized from the real monitor, HiDPI aware
Clipboard, audio mode, shared folders, RD Gateway support
Live session diagnostics with one-click disconnect

description.p: Scaling now defaults to smart sizing, so enlarging the window fills the canvas instead of leaving the session in the top-left corner.
Existing settings are migrated to the new default, while connections that chose dynamic resolution keep it.
The interface now speaks English as well as Chinese, following the system locale.
New Flatpak, AppImage, portable and Windows builds, on both x86_64 and arm64.
The dock and taskbar show the real application icon instead of a fallback.
Window and dialog sizes now follow the real monitor instead of hardcoded pixels.
The whole build and release pipeline runs on GitHub Actions.
